title: Challenge Timer
description: Server-side challenge timer that shows your playtime and in-game day in the action bar. Optional challenge mode: on death the run fails, the death screen is skipped and everyone goes spectator. Restart into a fresh world with one command.
body:
# Challenge Timer

**A lightweight, server-side challenge timer for Minecraft.** Track your playtime and in-game day right in the action bar, run death-is-failure challenges, and start fresh worlds on demand — all through simple `/ct` commands.

Perfect for speedruns, hardcore-style challenges, "how many days can you survive" runs, and multiplayer challenge servers.

---

## ✨ Features

- **⏱️ Live action-bar display** — shows your played time and the current in-game day, always visible while you play.
- **🎛️ Three display modes** — show the timer only, the day only, or both side by side.
- **💀 Challenge mode** — when a player dies, the challenge counts as **failed**: the timer freezes, the death screen is **skipped**, and everyone is instantly put into **spectator mode** with a bold *"Challenge failed"* title.
- **🌍 One-command world restart** — `/ct reset` deletes the world and generates a brand-new one with a **fresh random seed**. As a safety guard, it only runs when **all players are in spectator mode**.
- **🌐 Automatic language** — every message appears in **German** or **English**, automatically based on each player's game language. No config needed.
- **🪶 Server-side & lightweight** — runs entirely on the server. Players don't need to install anything.

---

## 🎮 Commands

All players can view info; changing settings requires operator/gamemaster permission (op level 2).

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/ct help` | Everyone | Show all commands |
| `/ct status` | Everyone | Show elapsed time, in-game day and all settings |
| `/ct mode both` | Operator | Display day **and** time |
| `/ct mode timer` | Operator | Display the time only |
| `/ct mode days` | Operator | Display the day only |
| `/ct challenge on` / `off` | Operator | Toggle: on death the challenge counts as failed |
| `/ct reset` | Operator | Restart the world with a new seed *(only if everyone is in spectator)* |

---

## ⚠️ Important: `/ct reset`

`/ct reset` **permanently deletes the current world** and regenerates it with a new seed — this **cannot be undone**. It is intentionally locked behind the requirement that **all online players are in spectator mode** (which naturally happens after a failed challenge). After the reset the server stops; simply re-open / rejoin the world to drop into the freshly generated world.

---

Works on dedicated servers and in singleplayer. Since it's server-side, only the server (or the world host) needs the mod.
